requirement: R6 - depth of the replacement, not just the fact of one

definitions.replacement_depth: The printed rank, on the club's own depth chart, of the first name in the slot who is not ruled out. 2 means a second-string player steps in; 3 means a third-string player; and so on.
definitions.reach: replacement_depth - 1. How many printed names the club must go past.
definitions.slot_exhausted: Every printed name in the slot is ruled out, so no replacement is printed. Published blank and flagged, never filled with a guess.
definitions.no_backup_printed: The club prints one name in the slot and no one behind him.

tiers.label: Official game status: Out
tiers.authority: The league states the player will not play.

tiers.label: Official game status: Questionable
tiers.authority: The league states a risk. Not an absence, so the depth below is the depth the club would need, not the depth it will use.

tiers.label: Did not participate in practice
tiers.authority: A practice status only. The league prints no game status for these players, so this tier is a weaker signal and is published separately rather than folded into the Out figures.

coverage.why_that_ceiling_matters: A replacement is only implied where the league prints a game status. For the other rows the report states a practice status and no game status, so no replacement is implied and no depth is computed.

headline_definition: A starter ruled out is a first-string name printed on the club's own chart who carries the official Out status. The replacement depth is that slot's printed rank of the first available name.

not_measured: No point value, probability or line adjustment is produced from a depth. A printed rank is an ordering, not a measurement of how good the replacement is, and no snap count or performance log was retrieved to turn it into one.
Snap share, target share and usage are not published by the official injury report, so the 'next man up' impact on a projection stays blank.
Houston's chart renders as an image on its club site, so Houston has no printed ranks and its depth is blank.
